visual-node:lineage:actor:developer.name: Developer / maintainer
visual-node:lineage:actor:developer.responsibility: Explores an unfamiliar codebase from system context to source evidence.

visual-node:lineage:external:browser-gra.name: Browser graphics platform
visual-node:lineage:external:browser-gra.responsibility: Provides the canvas, WebAssembly runtime, and WebGPU or WebGL2 surface used to render the atlas.

visual-node:lineage:external:source-repo.name: Source repository
visual-node:lineage:external:source-repo.responsibility: Supplies source references used to support architecture claims.

visual-node:lineage:system:okie.name: Okie
visual-node:lineage:system:okie.responsibility: Evidence-backed architecture atlas with semantic zoom and deterministic guided stories.

visual-node:lineage:container:architectu.name: Architecture model
visual-node:lineage:container:architectu.responsibility: Defines versioned architecture claims, evidence, views, hierarchy, zoom policy, and story state.

visual-node:lineage:container:rust-rende.name: Rust / WASM renderer
visual-node:lineage:container:rust-rende.responsibility: Validates, culls, hit-tests, animates, and draws scene-protocol objects through GPU-backed browser rendering.

visual-node:lineage:container:scene-comp.name: Scene compiler
visual-node:lineage:container:scene-comp.responsibility: Deterministically converts semantic architecture and stories into renderer scenes, patches, and timelines.

visual-node:lineage:container:tooling.name: Build and fixture tooling
visual-node:lineage:container:tooling.responsibility: Builds the WASM package and generates deterministic demo and stress fixtures.

visual-node:lineage:container:web-app.name: Atlas web app
visual-node:lineage:container:web-app.responsibility: Owns the browser shell, navigation, inspection, search, camera controls, and guided-story experience.

visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-n.name: Scoped scene and patch compilation
visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-n.responsibility: Selects a root-scoped view and diffs retained scenes into revisioned patches.

visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-p.name: TypeScript protocol mirror
visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-p.responsibility: Defines the TypeScript scene, patch, primitive, LOD, and timeline payloads sent to Rust.

visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-s.name: Scene compilation
visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-s.responsibility: Maps visible semantic entities and relations to bounded renderer objects and paths.

visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-s.name: Story compilation
visual-node:lineage:component:compiler-s.responsibility: Converts narrated focus steps into deterministic camera and emphasis keyframes.

visual-node:lineage:component:model-norm.name: Normalized state
visual-node:lineage:component:model-norm.responsibility: Stores qualified identities and indexed rows for snapshots, hierarchy, layouts, zoom bands, and stories.

visual-node:lineage:component:model-sche.name: Semantic schema
visual-node:lineage:component:model-sche.responsibility: Defines entities, relations, evidence, snapshots, views, stories, and user overrides.

visual-node:lineage:component:model-scop.name: Hierarchy selectors
visual-node:lineage:component:model-scop.responsibility: Reconstructs snapshots and selects a view scoped to a root entity.

visual-node:lineage:component:model-vali.name: Architecture validation
visual-node:lineage:component:model-vali.responsibility: Rejects invalid snapshots, views, stories, geometry, evidence, and overrides before compilation.

visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-e.name: Scene engine
visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-e.responsibility: Owns retained scene state, semantic LOD, visibility, camera, culling, hit testing, patches, and timeline sampling.

visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-g.name: GPU renderer
visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-g.responsibility: Builds mesh and glyph data, initializes WebGPU/WebGL2, and submits visible frame geometry.

visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-p.name: Versioned renderer protocol
visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-p.responsibility: Validates scene objects, representations, paths, patches, and timelines at the Rust boundary.

visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-w.name: Browser WASM bridge
visual-node:lineage:component:renderer-w.responsibility: Deserializes host payloads and exposes scene, patch, camera, visibility, picking, and timeline controls to JavaScript.

visual-node:lineage:component:tooling-fi.name: Fixture generator
visual-node:lineage:component:tooling-fi.responsibility: Compiles the checked semantic fixture into renderer scene and timeline JSON.

visual-node:lineage:component:tooling-st.name: Stress scene generator
visual-node:lineage:component:tooling-st.responsibility: Generates seeded large scenes for renderer profiling.

visual-node:lineage:component:tooling-wa.name: WASM build driver
visual-node:lineage:component:tooling-wa.responsibility: Selects release, profiling, or debug wasm-pack builds and reports missing prerequisites.

visual-node:lineage:component:web-naviga.name: Navigation and history
visual-node:lineage:component:web-naviga.responsibility: Canonicalizes shareable URL state and separates pushed navigation from replaced selection and camera state.

visual-node:lineage:component:web-proven.name: Evidence presentation
visual-node:lineage:component:web-proven.responsibility: Distinguishes observed facts, deterministic inference, and AI-authored explanation.

visual-node:lineage:component:web-render.name: Renderer host
visual-node:lineage:component:web-render.responsibility: Creates GPU or Canvas2D backends and forwards scene, camera, input, and visibility state.

visual-node:lineage:component:web-shell.name: Application shell
visual-node:lineage:component:web-shell.responsibility: Composes the canvas, level rail, search, inspector, diagnostics, and story controls.

visual-node:lineage:component:web-storie.name: Guided story player
visual-node:lineage:component:web-storie.responsibility: Frames story entities, interpolates camera flights, and presents deterministic focus and flow state.
